mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plt_dynamic_form_template_revision (id, template_id, revision_no, status_code, draft_marker, source_revision_id, form_conf_json, form_rules_json, engine_code, designer_version, renderer_version, published_by, published_at, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.templateId}, #{row.revisionNo}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.draftMarker}, #{row.sourceRevisionId}, #{row.formConfJson}, #{row.formRulesJson}, #{row.engineCode}, #{row.designerVersion}, #{row.rendererVersion}, #{row.publishedBy}, #{row.publishedAt}, #{row.version}, #{row.creator}, COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, NOW()), #{row.updater}, COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, NOW()), #{row.tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plt_dynamic_form_template_revision r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.id = #{query.revisionId} AND r.deleted = b'0'
SELECT FROM plt_dynamic_form_template_revision r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.template_id = #{query.templateId} AND r.id = #{query.revisionId} AND r.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM plt_dynamic_form_template_revision r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.template_id = #{query.templateId} AND r.status_code = 'DRAFT' AND r.draft_marker = 1 AND r.deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM plt_dynamic_form_template t JOIN plt_dynamic_form_template_revision r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND r.template_id = t.id AND r.id = t.current_published_revision_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND t.id = #{query.templateId} AND t.deleted = b'0' AND r.deleted = b'0' AND r.status_code = 'PUBLISHED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE plt_dynamic_form_template_revision SET form_conf_json = #{row.formConfJson}, form_rules_json = #{row.formRulesJson}, engine_code = #{row.engineCode}, designer_version = #{row.designerVersion}, renderer_version = #{row.rendererVersion}, version = version + 1, updater = #{row.updater}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND template_id = #{row.templateId} AND id = #{row.id} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND draft_marker = 1 AND version = #{row.version} AND deleted = b'0'

UPDATE plt_dynamic_form_template_revision SET status_code = 'PUBLISHED', draft_marker = NULL, published_by = #{update.publishedBy}, published_at = #{update.publishedAt}, version = version + 1, updater = #{update.updater}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND template_id = #{update.templateId} AND id = #{update.revisionId} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND draft_marker = 1 AND version = #{update.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
